Welcome to Nitro Tanks, an action-packed open-world tank simulator where speed breaks all the rules! Jump into powerful tanks equipped with nitro boosters, race across massive maps, launch off insane ramps, and literally fly through the air in epic stunts.

🔥 Features:

Huge open world to explore
Powerful tanks with nitro acceleration
Crazy jumps, ramps, and airborne stunts
Fun free-roam gameplay with non-stop action
Unlock and upgrade different tanks
Pure arcade-style chaos and speed

Whether you want to drift across deserts, soar over cliffs, or just boost at insane speeds—Nitro Tanks is all about freedom, speed, and destruction!

Start your engine, hit the nitro, and fly like a tank has never flown before! 🏎️💨

games.name: 👾 Casual Stock [BETA]
games.desc:
👋 Welcome to the world of resale! Here you will become a fearless hunter of cool brand-name clothes in the ruthless world of second-hand goods. Your goal is to turn a modest initial investment into a huge business by selling rare and stylish items to collectors. 

Every 10 minutes, you immerse yourself in an atmosphere of anticipation and excitement as new items arrive. Different stores appear before you, each with its own unique selection, including various styles, eras, and brands. From vintage T-shirts with logos of iconic rock bands to rare designer hoodies.

You will need to apply your analytical skills to quickly assess the value of each item and make purchasing decisions. The ever-changing market requires flexibility and intuition to determine which items will be most in demand and profitable. But be careful, not everything that glitters is truly a golden nugget of fashion. Stay vigilant and avoid counterfeits!
